newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA - FARMA TO RAISE PROFIT FORECAST.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - FARMA TO RAISE PROFIT FORECAST.

text.p: Tallinna Farmaatsiatehas said on Friday that its board planned to raise its 1997 profit forecast of 30 million kroons to 40-50 million kroons.
"I do not want to speculate, but the new forecast will be about 40-50 million kroons," Priit Kivi, the firm's chairman, told Reuters.
Kivi added that the company was also revising its turnover figure for 1997 to around 260 million kroons from 200 million kroons.
"The projects we have been working on for two years are in place," he said.
Farmaatsiatehas earlier announced it had signed an agreement to establish a factory in Russia.
The company is also working on a project to get lower import tariffs to Russia, Kivi added.
The board will propose the new profit forecast at the next council meeting, which is due in two weeks, Kivi said.
